engines.session_full_publish: the project session with Spike 2 publication: every artifact is rewritten on every revision and CSS is re-aggregated from every contribution. The reference the other two are measured against.
engines.session_incremental_publish: the project session publishing only the output delta: an artifact whose content digest matches the published one is reused rather than rewritten, and an artifact no longer claimed is removed. CSS is still aggregated in full, so this row isolates publication.
engines.session_incremental_publish_css: the project session with delta publication AND incremental CSS aggregation: the stylesheet is re-derived from the changed rule contributions rather than from the whole atom population.
